Message:
net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: avoid writing the same mode

There is no need to change the 802.1Q port mode for the same value.
Thus avoid such message:

    [  401.954836] dsa dsa@0 lan0: 802.1Q Mode: Disabled (was Disabled)
